name: Pacific Cycling Road
why: the long one: the whole Pacific side from Chōshi round the Kii peninsula, with the Tokyo Bay ferry in the middle
note: National cycle route Chōshi → Taiji, 1,400 km, Japan's longest · Kujūkuri beach, the Bōsō coast, the Tokyo Bay ferry to Kurihama, Kamakura, Fuji from the coast, Ise, the Kii peninsula · blue arrows most of the way
